name: public-json-parser-corpus-v1
selection: Selected before jsonmodem/orjson timings. These are existing parser benchmark documents, not a sample of all application traffic.

upstream-data-terms.status: Original data terms are unresolved. No redistribution permission is asserted.
upstream-data-terms.note: Download from upstream for local measurements. Publish metadata and results, not these documents. The simdjson-data README names benchmarking as an intended use and asks users to check each file's terms; a parser repository's software license is not a license for copied API responses or other third-party data.

chinese-poetry-mit.status: The original data project declares MIT terms.
chinese-poetry-mit.note: yyjson_benchmark identifies chinese-poetry as the source. This file contains author biographies, not just ancient verse. The source project's declaration is recorded here; it is not an independent audit of every biography's origin. Keep the upstream notice with any redistributed data.

noto-ofl.status: The font's embedded name table explicitly states SIL Open Font License 1.1.
noto-ofl.note: An otfcc export of Noto Sans JP Regular 1.004. Copyright 2014, 2015 Adobe Systems Incorporated. Name-table entries 13 and 14 identify the license and its URL. No font data is committed to this repository.

boost-json.description: Documents listed in Boost.JSON's parsing/serialization comparison with RapidJSON and nlohmann/json.

simdjson-data.description: Additional documents from simdjson's public testing and benchmarking collection.

yyjson.description: Documents listed in yyjson_benchmark's dataset table.

documents.name: apache_builds
documents.description: Apache Jenkins build metadata; nested objects and arrays.

documents.name: canada
documents.description: Canada border coordinates; many short arrays of floating-point numbers. Also used by nativejson-benchmark, serde-rs/json-benchmark, and orjson.

documents.name: citm_catalog
documents.description: Indented catalog with repeated keys, integers, strings, and nested containers. Also used by nativejson-benchmark, serde-rs/json-benchmark, and orjson.

documents.name: github_events
documents.description: GitHub API events; an array of nested records.

documents.name: google_maps_api_response
documents.description: A smaller indented Google Maps API response.

documents.name: gsoc-2018
documents.description: Google Summer of Code metadata with longer ASCII strings.

documents.name: instruments
documents.description: Financial instrument metadata with large objects.

documents.name: marine_ik
documents.description: A three.js model with numeric arrays and nested metadata.

documents.name: mesh
documents.description: A compact 3D mesh with floating-point numbers.

documents.name: numbers
documents.description: An array containing only floating-point numbers.

documents.name: random
documents.description: Mixed data with many Cyrillic characters.

documents.name: semanticscholar-corpus
documents.description: An array of academic metadata records, larger than the common Canada/CITM/Twitter cases.

documents.name: tree-pretty
documents.description: An indented tree of nested objects.

documents.name: twitter
documents.description: Twitter API data with CJK characters. Also used by nativejson-benchmark, serde-rs/json-benchmark, and orjson; their copies can differ in whitespace.

documents.name: twitterescaped
documents.description: Twitter data with Unicode escapes and less whitespace. Keep this distinct for loads; do not count identical dumps inputs twice.

documents.name: update-center
documents.description: Jenkins update-center metadata with strings and nested objects.

documents.name: poet
documents.description: Chinese author biographies; an array with long CJK strings.

documents.name: otfcc
documents.description: A 66 MB Noto Sans JP font export with many nested numeric records.

exclusions: No third-party JSON documents are redistributed in this repository.
JSONTestSuite and similar malformed-input collections are correctness tests, not throughput baselines.
mesh.pretty.json is omitted because mesh.json already represents those values.
The yyjson fgo game-data export is omitted; the other selected documents provide a large-file contrast without it.
Compact Google Maps/Twitter API variants and repeated copies across parser repositories are omitted to avoid unnecessary weighting of the same content.
